title: Hours and location
summary: Address, opening hours as aligned rows, and a directions link that opens the visitor's own maps app. Use on a home or visit page for any business with a street address. Avoid an embedded map iframe: it is heavy and traps scroll.
a11y: Hours are a description list whose rows share one label column (subgrid), so times align whatever the longest label; the directions link says it opens a map.
truth: Hours, address and phone come from the business's facts (the manifest's business), never typed into the block.
schemaOrg: openingHoursSpecification (from the same structured hours the rows are derived from)
